chronology.burned_2026: NOT_RUN_PINNED_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE unless the exact pinned bytes exist; Week 5+ never accessed
chronology.no_rescue: No tuning, new family, threshold change or grid extension after development results are seen.
chronology.refit: 2024 weeks 1-18 with frozen hyperparameters, only after a selection pass
chronology.validation: 2025 weeks 1-18, opened ONLY if a family (or the survivor combination) survives development on a head

competent_human_snap_baseline.definition: raw_i = phase1d_share_i * (1 + 1.0 * clip(snap_persist_i, -0.3, 0.3)) for non-QB players; snap_persist_i = mean(last two lag-eligible snap pct) - mean(previous up to three) when BOTH of the last two differ from that mean by >= 0.10 in the same direction, else 0; players without a snap series keep the Phase1D share; non-QB mass renormalised to the Phase1D non-QB mass
competent_human_snap_baseline.name: C3S

downstream: ONLY if workload survives on a head: frozen-efficiency diagnostic with no efficiency change; yards, receptions and touchdowns are never promotion gates
forbidden: depth charts, injuries, participation as features

heads.independence: heads are fitted, selected and judged separately

receiving.population: EXACTLY the frozen Phase1D fixed meaningful rows for receiving (prior-3 average >= 3 targets with >= 2 prior games; active eligible roster)

rushing.population: frozen Phase1D fixed meaningful rows for rushing (prior-3 average >= 5 carries, >= 2 prior games) restricted to RB/FB/HB players so QB scrambles are not mixed into the RB carry evaluation; QB shares are held fixed at the Phase1D value and the non-QB mass is preserved (QB mass is never moved by the candidate)

metrics.coherence: max |sum of non-QB shares - Phase1D non-QB mass| and non-negativity; candidate never changes team volume
metrics.primary: oracle player opportunity = predicted share x ACTUAL team opportunity (isolates the role); secondary coupled = predicted share x frozen Phase1B team projection
receiving: target share MAE and signed bias
rushing: carry share MAE and signed bias

model_class.fit_rows: 2024 W1-8 active eligible non-QB roster players with >= 1 prior team game (stat history) AND >= 1 lag-eligible snap observation; target = actual share (0 when no stat row) minus Phase1D share
model_class.form: predicted share_i = max(0, phase1d_share_i + ridge_delta_i) for non-QB players with a snap series, then renormalised so the non-QB mass equals the Phase1D non-QB mass (receiving: 1.0, shares sum to 1; rushing: QB shares fixed)

oracle_forensics: POSTGAME DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: role error (actual team volume x predicted share), team-volume error (Phase1B projection x actual share), errors by actual target-game snap bucket and by actual target-game snap-change category (target-game snap pct minus prior snap trailing-3: up >= 0.15, down <= -0.15), and the share of rows where snaps rose but opportunity share did not; never used for fitting, selection or promotion

practical_thresholds.rule: gain >= max(absolute, 5% of the comparator MAE) vs BOTH C1 and C3S individually on 2024 W9-18 primary rows, AND paired block-bootstrap upper-95 of (candidate - comparator) < 0 (seed 20261201, 2000 reps, moving 2-consecutive-week blocks of complete team-weeks), AND catastrophic miss rate (>6 targets / >10 carries) not more than 0.005 above the comparator, AND coherence passes
practical_thresholds.slice_rule: the SNAP_CHANGED slice must improve >= 5% relative vs the strongest of C1/C2/C3S on that slice and the SNAP_ROLE_STABLE slice must not worsen by more than 2% relative (applied at 2025; reported at development)
practical_thresholds.tiny_wins: A gain below the absolute threshold never qualifies.

preregistration: Committed before any Phase1Q predictive result exists. The Phase1O family B hypothesis (snap-change) was BLOCKED_DATA, never tested; Phase1P resolved the identity blocker (PHASE1Q_SNAP_CAN_OPEN). Only snap families A-F below are tested. The other Phase1O families (recency, concentration, vacancy, rookie, change-point, competition) were rejected and are NOT rerun or combined.
question: Does prior-completed-game offensive snap deployment contain information about future target share/targets and carry share/carries beyond frozen Phase1D (before box-score opportunity fully catches up)?
receipts: every 2024 primary player-game of the best development family per head: player, GSIS and PFR ids, team, opponent, position, Phase1D share, prior snap, trailing-3, trailing-5, acceleration, regime flags, teammate snap changes, divergence, candidate adjustment, final predicted share, frozen team opportunity, predicted and actual share and opportunities, errors, source hashes, mapping provenance
reproducibility: explicit left-to-right float accumulation; sorted-key JSON rounded to 6 decimals; digest-pinned inputs; no mutable upstream file is read
scope: Player WORKLOAD only. No yards, no touchdowns, no efficiency change, no team-volume change (Phase1N rejected, not reopened), no Monte Carlo, no sportsbook, no paid data, no 2026 data, no Week 5+.

B_snap_acceleration: slope of the last up to 5
C_snap_regime: up_mid_to_full: previous trailing-3 in [0.25,0.60) and last >= 0.60
consecutive_full_games: consecutive >= 0.60 games ending at the last (cap 5)

definition: div_gain = snap acceleration (last - m3) - K * (last share - mean of previous 3 shares)
D_snap_opportunity_divergence.note: K are fixed interpretable snap-to-opportunity exchange rates, not fitted

E_teammate_redistribution: teammate snap gain sum (positive accelerations of same-position-group teammates)
group snap HHI over trailing-3 snaps
committee compression = HHI of last-game snaps minus HHI of trailing-5 snaps
own acceleration minus mean teammate acceleration
signal_families.F_position_routing: position (WR/TE/RB) interactions of the SURVIVING snap features only; tested only after at least one of A-E survives; never a large feature set
signal_families.H_survivor_combination: only families that each survive development on that head are combined

snap_role_flags.SNAP_ROLE_STABLE: otherwise (including players without a snap series)
snap_role_flags.SNAP_ROLE_UP: last lag-eligible snap pct minus previous trailing-3 mean >= +0.15
snap_role_flags.actual_change: actual share - prior-3 team share reference >= tau (up) / <= -tau (down); tau 0.05 targets, 0.10 carries
reports: workload MAE vs Phase1D on the flagged slices

sources.identity: Phase1P exact rules: canonical frozen extract + pinned roster crosswalk (nfl_v2_phase1p_snap_mapping.resolve); no names
sources.snap_counts: pinned nflverse snap_counts 2023-2025 (digests in phase1o_role_protocol.json); regular season; rows with offense_pct > 0; absent player-games on an observed team stint count as 0
sources.weekly_stats_rosters: pinned 2023-2025 stats and rosters as in Phase1D/Phase1O

temporal_availability.audit: nflverse snap_counts is scraped from Pro-Football-Reference; the pinned files carry no publication timestamp, so exact availability is unknown.
temporal_availability.rule: A prior team-game contributes snap information to a target game only if prior_game_date + 4 days <= target_game_date (gameday from the frozen schedule). This is one day more conservative than the V2 history rule (game_date + 3 days, Phase1N), so a Sunday game is usable on the following Thursday or later, while Monday-to-Thursday and Thursday-to-Sunday turnarounds exclude the immediately preceding game for snaps (the weekly-stat share history used by Phase1D is unchanged).
temporal_availability.stint_rule: a player's snap series for a team starts at his first observed offensive-snap game with that team among lag-eligible games and includes later absences as 0; the last 5 lag-eligible team-games are used
temporal_availability.target_game_snaps: POSTGAME ONLY; used solely in oracle forensics and receipts after evaluation, never in fitting, selection or promotion

verdicts.BLOCKED_DATA: 2025 snap mapping below 95% or required pinned inputs unavailable
verdicts.PARTIAL: a family improves Phase1D by at least the practical threshold on a point estimate but the full standard is not met
verdicts.SURVIVES: development pass AND untouched 2025 pass with the slice rule, coherence preserved, 2025 snap mapping >= 95%
